target.statement: IE achieves AUROC 0.941 on HumanEval with 130M parameters (vs SWEET 15.5B at 0.944)
target.table_ref: Table 1, row IE, column HUMANEVAL AUROC

compute.basis: Requires downloading StarCoder-15.5B (~31GB) and SimCSE, generating watermarked code for 164 HumanEval problems, training the 130M entropy tagger MLP, and running detection; all feasible on CPU but slow due to the 15.5B model inference.

blockers: StarCoder-15.5B is large (~31GB) and slow on CPU
Entropy tagger training requires preprocessing MBPP with StarCoder entropy labels
title: Invisible Entropy: Towards Safe and Efficient Low-Entropy LLM Watermarking
